If humans evolved from apes, why are there still apes? 🐒

It's a trick question. We never evolved from today's apes. Humans and chimps share a common ancestor and split from it roughly 7 million years ago, and both branches have been evolving ever since. They aren't our ancestors. They're our cousins.
